content.short: Dojoswap is Injective's first native community-driven AMM DEX, featuring the DOJO token and deep liquidity for trading.
content.description: Dojoswap is the first native, community-driven decentralized exchange and AMM built on Injective. It provides users with a fast, low-cost, and transparent trading experience while fostering a vibrant ecosystem for project launches and liquidity. Powered by the DOJO token, the protocol facilitates governance, staking rewards, and revenue-sharing. By leveraging Injective's infrastructure, Dojoswap serves as a central hub for liquidity, enabling seamless asset exchange and empowering users to grow the Injective ecosystem through secure, on-chain trading and decentralized governance for all participants.
